text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has come once again. This time last year, King Halo was in the midst of the Classic Triple Crown tour, but now she's focused only on her own path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week approaches and asks which race King Halo plans to run in next, but the conversation is interrupted and the two promise to speak again later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps a new fire has been lit by their paths diverging. In any case, they remain rivals.
